secondLook.note: PUBLISH-FIX-79, owner directive 2026-09-19 (David: 'fix the thing that will make him miss the winners'): a look refused ONLY on buying-pressure gates (FI15, FI60_POSITIVE, RV60, the absorption priors) is retaken 3 minutes later at the same level if the coin still holds it — a fresh crossing, a fresh lock, every gate at full strength — up to 2 times per chain. No threshold moves. Set OFF for the baseline Judge.

gateLearning.note: PUBLISH-FIX-82, owner directive 2026-09-19 (David: 'I want him to move the gate once it's tested enough — thousands and thousands of tests — without me having to say so'): the Judge's flow lines (FI15, FI60_POSITIVE, RV60, RECLAIM_FI15, FI15_FRESH_AT_D; judge/setups.js LEARNABLE_GATES, each inside a fixed band) are moved by his own scored looks: a move needs minScored scored looks on the gate, minCohort in the cohort it changes and bootstrap confidence the admitted looks' 15-minute return does not fall; it is PROPOSED, forward-tested on minForward looks scored after the proposal, then PUBLISHED; a published line that stops holding is REVERTED. One step per gate per cycle; the study runs every 30 minutes in a child process. Every move is one line in the log. Set OFF for the reference lines.
